claims.exact_statement: For every n>=1 and every f:{0,1}^n->{-1,1} with spectral law P=fhat^2 (base-2 logs), every coordinate i and children g_s=f restricted to x_i=s (s=0,1): TC(f) = I_P(S_i;S_-i) - JS(P_{g_0},P_{g_1}) + Gamma_i + (TC(g_0)+TC(g_1))/2, where TC(g)=D(P_g||prod_j Ber(Inf_j(g)))=sum_j h2(Inf_j(g))-H(P_g) and Gamma_i=sum_{j!=i} JS(Ber(Inf_j(g_0)),Ber(Inf_j(g_1)))>=0. Consequently, for every adaptive restriction tree with internal nodes h (weight p_h=2^-depth, restricting coordinate i_h of node function g_h) and leaves l: sum_h p_h I_h + sum_h p_h Gamma_h + sum_l p_l TC(g_l) = TC(f) + sum_h p_h JS_h, and the posterior credit satisfies sum_h p_h I_h <= TC(f) + (2/ln2) I(f); the erasure paid is sum_h p_h B_h = sum_h p_h h2(Inf_{i_h}(g_h)) - sum_h p_h I_h.
hypotheses: C005 bound JS_i <= (2/ln2) min(Inf_i, 1-Inf_i) (used only for the credit cap)

claims.exact_statement: For every n>=1 and every f:{0,1}^n->{-1,1} with spectral law P=fhat^2, let M_edge(f)=sum_S P(S) sum_{i in S} log2(1+P(S\{i})/P(S)) (terms with P(S)=0 omitted) and B(f)=sum_i H(S_i|S_-i). Then M_edge(f) <= B(f) <= M_edge(f) + log2(e) I(f). Hence FEI holds with an absolute constant if and only if there is an absolute K with M_edge(f) <= K I(f) for all Boolean f; FEI with constant C gives K<=C, and K gives FEI with C <= K + log2(e) + 2/ln2.
hypotheses: B <= H (dual total correlation is nonnegative)
C018: B(g) <= K' I(g) for all Boolean g implies FEI with C <= K' + 2/ln2 (reverse direction only)
